items.title: Everyday Applications of Machine Learning (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Everyday Applications of Machine Learning' under topic 6.5 (PDF 81, printed 77).

blocks.text: Machine learning rozana ke kaamon mein istemal hoti hai. Mobile phones isay face recognition (chehra pehchan kar phone kholna) ke liye istemal karte hain. Voice assistants bole hue commands samajhte hain. Social media har shakhs ko us ki pasand ka content dikhata hai. Email services spam messages alag kar deti hain. Navigation apps raste batati hain. Online platforms videos aur music tajweez karte hain. Smart devices machine learning istemal karte hain, aur rozana ke kaam asaan aur tez ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Pakistan ki rozmarra zindagi se machine learning ka ek istemal batayein, aur bataein ke yeh zyada tar classification (darja-bandi), prediction (andaza) ya recommendation (tajweez) hai.
blocks.explanation: Misal: ride-hailing app ka kiraya aur pohanchne ka waqt batana prediction hai; phone ka spam call warning dena classification hai; video app ka drame tajweez karna recommendation hai. (Doosri munasib misalein bhi sahi hain.)

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa: 6.5 Applications of Machine Learning

items: Healthcare: medical data se bimari ki pehchan aur tashkhees.
Business: customer behavior, sales ka andaza, inventory, fraud, chatbots, product tajaweez.
Education: performance par nazar, personalized parhai, smart attendance aur assessment.
Rozmarra: face recognition, voice assistants, spam filter, navigation, recommendations.
